_source: HY26 Results Announcement 31 March 2026 (Compass Group plc UK food services FTSE 100)

kpis.description_fr: Premier sector business (40% du CA H1 FY26). Restauration entreprise, marchés B2B premium. Croissance forte +15% portée par tarification et nouveaux contrats.
kpis.description_en: Largest business sector (40% of H1 FY26 sales). Corporate dining, premium B2B markets. Strong +15% growth driven by pricing and new contracts.

kpis.description_fr: Restauration hospitalière et maisons de retraite (22% du CA). Marché défensif, peu cyclique. Cible de croissance via M&A (acquisition Pro Care Mgmt Germany $270m).
kpis.description_en: Hospital and senior living catering (22% of sales). Defensive, low-cyclical market. M&A growth target (Pro Care Mgmt Germany acquisition $270m).

kpis.description_fr: Restauration scolaire et universitaire. Marché stable, calendrier décalé (8-9 mois/an). Récurrent.
kpis.description_en: School and university catering. Stable market, offset calendar (8-9 months/year). Recurring.

kpis.description_fr: Stades, événements sportifs, parcs d'attractions. Croissance forte +13%, sensible aux grands événements (JO Paris 2024 base).
kpis.description_en: Stadiums, sporting events, theme parks. Strong +13% growth, sensitive to major events (Paris 2024 Olympics base).

kpis.name_fr: Revenus Défense Offshore et Sites Isolés
kpis.description_fr: Bases militaires, plateformes offshore, sites miniers isolés. Marges supérieures, barrières à l'entrée fortes.
kpis.description_en: Military bases, offshore platforms, remote mining sites. Higher margins, strong entry barriers.

kpis.description_fr: Taux de rétention clients (% du CA conservé). KPI structurel du business model contrats long-terme. 96% = excellence sectorielle.
kpis.description_en: Client retention rate (% of revenue retained). Structural KPI of long-term contract business model. 96% = sector-leading.

kpis.description_fr: Nouveaux contrats signés sur la période (4.1 Mds $ en H1 FY26, +14% YoY). Moitié sont du first-time outsourcing (marché en expansion).
kpis.description_en: New contracts signed in the period ($4.1bn H1 FY26, +14% YoY). Half from first-time outsourcing (expanding market).

notes: Source: HY26 Results 31 March 2026 (semestriel). Annual report FY25 (year ended 30 Sept 2025) référencé mais non disponible localement. History sur 2 points seulement (H1 FY25 / H1 FY26).
